title: 第1章 生吞妖核
content_zh:
广袤无垠的玄天大陆东部，古苍山脉边缘落凰城，三大家族之一的李家族府药房重地中。

“黎晨，今天是你最后一次试药，明日三小姐会把你带到玄云宗，送给她一位师兄做药奴！”

监管药奴的李明云，眉头微皱的看着墙壁下，半人高水缸中，被锁住双手，尽数泡在散发刺鼻气味药液中的疤面少年。

黎晨瑟缩着脖子垂下头，发丝遮掩了他目中一闪而过的屈辱与不甘，扬起头时，已然化作了平日里的怯懦。

李明云面无表情的取出一个玉瓶，倒出一枚拇指肚大小，晶莹圆润的丹药，屈指轻弹，流光闪过径直落入黎晨口中。

丹药甫一入口，黎晨面上青筋暴起，遮盖了大半个左脸颊的暗红色疤痕，隐晦的闪过血芒，与其面上的青肿相应，整个面孔扭曲，使得他凭添了数分狰狞恶感。

铁链哗啦啦作响中，嘶吼足足持续了盏茶工夫，黎晨才渐渐平复下来，头顶之上赫然多了一个淡淡乳灰色的气旋。

“气旋天成，这荒蛮之地，难得出一个有着能够达到丹旋境资质的小辈，可惜是个天生经脉堵塞，无法凝聚内息的废物！”

李明云眉头微皱，面色阴郁，似是想起了什么不快的往事。

但其话语却是惊人无比，要知道，整个李家最强的也不过是那位隐居多年的老太爷，传闻其乃是煅真境的高手。

看其俨然更将在其之上的丹旋境武者都不放在眼里的样子，在黎晨的嘶哑呼喝与不断蒸腾的雾气掩映下，昏暗的药房内，李明云的神情话语一下子显得神秘无比起来。

“回大人，紫荆花、墨云草的药味有些重，应该是放的多了！”

大半个时辰后，黎晨缓缓醒来，满面红光，面上被三小姐教训所留的青肿，也是消去了不少，自行解开手镣，从水缸中走出。

李明云随手取出纸笔记录了一番，挥手让他下去，只是看着他的身影，深邃的眸子中，满是疑惑：“这小子体质当真特殊，竟然不惧废丹中的毒性，还能熬炼肉身，三年来连我都找不出问题在哪，若非他的经脉问题，倒也算是一个不错的选择！”

翌日清晨，在欢送三小姐李月蓉出落凰城的族人漠视中，一众仆役的不屑注视下，黎晨踏上了玄云宗属地。

时光荏茬，如白驹过隙，一晃黎晨已在玄云宗待了数月。

昏暗的夜空，朦胧可见五指，落云峰偏僻山坳中，正有一人背靠着井沿坐地，身畔两个硕大木桶。

捶捏了一番酸疼的肩膀，黎晨深吸口气，硬撑着疲乏的身体，将扁担抗到肩上，这已是今天第七趟，饶是他体力惊人，堪比内息境三四层武者，也被累得够呛。

这数月来的工作，除了验证丹药是否成功，讲出失败丹药的药理之外，便是打扫院落与挑水。

若非其肉身多年来经废丹毒性熬炼，正常没有内息之人，恐怕要活活累死不可。

满含杀意的爆喝，令得正待起身的黎晨悚然一惊，身形一矮的躲在了木桶后，稍微露出头来看向远处。

漆黑的夜光下，一双眸子，异样目光闪过。

不远处树林中，嘭嘭连响，金铁交鸣传荡，所谓月黑风高杀人夜，正是此时的真实写照。

这里地处偏僻，又有树林与乱石堆遮掩，声音根本传不出去。

也就是黎晨这里，正处在下方，才能听的真切。

盏茶工夫后，远处再度隐隐传来一声惨叫，接着便是跌跌撞撞的声音，由远及近的向此地传来，令得躲藏中的黎晨心底咯噔一声。

他藏在这里，不是为了什么渔翁得利，而是不想被明显玄云宗弟子争斗之人发现。

以他奴仆的身份，任何弟子都可以踩一脚，若是被发现，等待他的只有杀人灭口。

有人的地方就有争斗，自小因为面容缺陷，兼之身体不能凝聚内息，虽然不过十四五岁，但内心却极为成熟的黎晨，早已看惯世态炎凉，人情冷暖。

在玄云宗数月来，他可是听闻了不少，宗门弟子间显然没有想象中的和睦，失踪个把弟子更是常事。

骨碌碌滚动连响，带动着一片碎石呼啦啦向这山坳而来。

黎晨死死盯着那处黑影滑落的地方，足足憋了盏茶工夫。

眼见再无动静传来，黎晨犹豫了好一会，这才起身大着胆子靠了过去。

依稀可见，两名青衣弟子趴伏在乱石中，一动不动，黎晨识得，那是外门弟子的专有服饰。

其中一人，蓦然艰难的咳嗽数声，扬起的头颅，正正看到黎晨，“救我！”

黎晨激灵灵打个寒颤，犹豫了一番，心底善念让他试探着走近，伸手向此人肩膀扶去。

一抹亮光闪过黎晨双目，那是兵刃寒芒，刹那间，黎晨寒毛卓竖，多次被李家三小姐李月蓉暴打练就的反应力，在这一刻使他处乱不惊，毫不犹豫身子向后仰躺，一脚踢出。

接连两声闷响，那人被一脚踹飞，撞到乱石中，张口喷出一道血箭，寒光闪烁的匕首当啷掉落，趴伏在地抽搐几下没了声息。

狠狠喘了几口粗气，黎晨吞咽了下口水，望着再也没有了声息的青衣人，心底这才升起一抹后怕之意。

但随即，一股剧痛袭上心头，下意识的向胸口看去。

左胸口下方，血渍涔涔而出，霎时间一股冰寒覆盖全身，那是失血过多所致。

“不......我不甘心......我还......还没有成就武者......让......让爷爷......瞑......瞑目......”

噗通一声，黎晨眼前一阵模糊，仰躺倒地，口中喃喃呓语，更是有大股的血沫涌出。

入玄云宗不过数月，虽然平日里甚苦，但在这等宗门内，说不定哪天就有际遇，可以解除体内桎梏，可以如常人一般修理内息，完成老黎头的心愿。

却不想，今日善心方动，却遭此厄难，当真是应了老黎头当年常挂在嘴边的一句话——人心叵测！

坚毅的心志，支撑着他没有昏死过去，用力的侧翻身体，探手向躺倒的另一人怀中摸去。

黎晨认得，那是玄云宗外门弟子配发的下品聚息丹，可惜对他无用。

强忍着心头昏沉，再一探手，是一个巴掌大小的玉匣，费力的将之掏出打开，内里赫然是一颗核桃大小，斑驳不堪，散发淡淡荧光的晶核。

黎晨双目微缩，深吸口气，看着这颗妖核，目中光芒闪烁不定。

虽然知晓两者必然会为了某种宝物争夺，但怎么也想不到会是妖核。

看这妖核的体积，赫然是一阶后期妖兽所有，这等实力，必须要凝息境七层之上的武者才能应对。

这等妖核，足以比拟数颗上品聚息丹，甚至于能比得上十数颗。

李家三年专职药奴，各种废丹、成丹，不管何种药性，除了身体比普通武者强了许多外，都对他无用。

唯独妖核，他从未见过，更遑论尝试！

但妖核却不能直接服用，其内蕴含了妖兽独有的妖气，乃是一种极为暴躁，破坏力极强的力量。

若贸然服用，必然会被妖气撕裂经脉爆体而亡，强大的武者，可以凭借修为炼化祛除妖气，亦或者用特殊手段，但也只是对修为比自己低的妖核而言，修为相当，则极难成功。

对黎晨这等连内息都没有的人而言，莫说是一阶后期妖核，就算是初期，也足以让他当场毙命，更遑论他现在身受重伤。

越来越虚弱的身体，黎晨打了个摆子，一咬牙，张口将妖核整个塞入口中。

咕咚一声吞下肚，没有想象中的坚硬，只是一阵冰凉划过全身，令黎晨激灵灵打个寒颤，接着便是一股剧痛从肚腹中传遍全身。

死命的压抑着体内剧痛，周身冷汗涔涔滑落，黎晨死命的咬牙坚持，猛地起身盘膝坐地，双手握于丹田，运行起这三年来熟的不能再熟的李家人阶高级功法《融阳诀》。

这还是当年他初做药奴，仅仅月余便达到凝练内息的地步，李家高层为了拉拢他才特别赐下，甚至有意结亲，结果他却是一个无法凝聚内息的废体。

体内气血翻腾，接连喷吐了三道血箭，那如撕裂灵魂的剧痛，饶是黎晨受了三年废丹炼体之苦，差点承受不住，散了功诀。

好在他的心志早已磨练的极为坚毅，硬生生撑了下来，只是左胸处的伤口，在狂暴妖力的激荡下，登时喷出了一蓬血雾。

满面青筋凸起，双目暴睁满是血丝，黎晨只觉身体整个都要爆裂开来，任谁也看不到，其左脸颊处的丑陋疤痕，蓦地闪过一抹慑人的暗红色血芒。

蛮荒大地万族林立，妖魔纵横，人族天赋中庸羸弱，饲为猪狗圈养，却不知自知，以灵长自居！

少年阿蛮不忿苟活，偶得逆天造化本源神物，凭坚韧不拔之心，生死磨砺，始创绝世神通——乾坤九变！

闯九幽，灭九阳，诛妖魔，逆流洪荒，制霸荒古，万灵俯首，翻手为云覆手为雨，以最霸道野蛮的手段，开创蛮神纪元！

content_en:
In the eastern part of the vast Xuantian Continent, on the edge of the Gucang Mountains, Huangcheng falls, in the center of the pharmacy of the Li Family Mansion, one of the three major families.

"Li Chen, today is your last time to test the medicine. Tomorrow the third lady will take you to Xuanyun Sect and give you to one of her senior brothers as a medicine slave!"

Li Mingyun, who was supervising the medicine slaves, frowned slightly as he looked at the scarred boy under the wall, whose hands were locked in a water tank about half a person high, soaking in the pungent-smelling medicine.

Li Chen curled his neck and lowered his head. His hair covered up the flash of humiliation and unwillingness in his eyes. When he raised his head, it had turned into his usual cowardice.

Li Mingyun took out a jade bottle with an expressionless face, poured out a round and round elixir the size of his thumb, flicked it with his fingers, and the light flashed directly into Li Chen's mouth.

As soon as the elixir was taken into his mouth, veins popped up on Li Chen's face, covering most of the dark red scar on his left cheek. There was a faint flash of blood, corresponding to the bruises on his face, and his entire face was distorted, making him feel even more ferocious.

The iron chain rattled and the roar lasted for a long time before Li Chen gradually calmed down, and there was a faint milky gray cyclone above his head.

"Cyclone Tiancheng, in this barbaric land, it is rare to find a junior who has the qualifications to reach the Danxuan realm, but it is a pity that he is a waste who is born with blocked meridians and cannot condense his inner energy!"

Li Mingyun frowned slightly, his expression gloomy, as if he remembered some unpleasant past events.

But his words were extremely astonishing. You must know that the strongest person in the entire Li family is just the old man who has lived in seclusion for many years. It is rumored that he is a master of the True Realm.

Seeing how he seemed to ignore the Danxuan realm warriors above him, Li Mingyun's expression and words in the dim pharmacy suddenly seemed extremely mysterious under Li Chen's hoarse shouts and the steaming mist.

"Sir, the medicinal smell of redbud and black cloud grass is a bit strong, I must have added too much!"

More than half an hour later, Li Chen woke up slowly, his face glowing red, and the bruises on his face caused by the Third Miss's lessons had also faded a lot. He unshackled himself and walked out of the water tank.

Li Mingyun casually took out a pen and paper and took notes, then waved him off, but looked at his figure, his deep eyes full of doubts: "This guy's physique is really special. He is not afraid of the toxicity in the waste pill, and he can also temper his body. Even I can't find the problem in the past three years. If it weren't for his meridians, it would be a good choice!"

The next morning, Li Chen set foot on the territory of the Xuanyun Sect, amidst the indifference of the tribesmen who were sending Miss Li Yuerong off to Phoenix City, and the disdainful gazes of the servants.

Time flies by like a fleeting moment, and Li Chen has been staying at Xuanyun Sect for several months.

In the dim night sky, five fingers were dimly visible. In the remote mountain col of Luoyun Peak, there was a man sitting with his back against the edge of a well, with two huge wooden barrels beside him.

After squeezing his sore shoulders, Li Chen took a deep breath, braced his tired body, and put the pole on his shoulders. This was the seventh time today. Even though he had amazing physical strength, comparable to a third- and fourth-level warrior in the Inner Breath Realm, he was still exhausted.

The work in the past few months, apart from verifying whether the elixir was successful and explaining the pharmacology of failed elixirs, was cleaning the courtyard and fetching water.

If his body had not been tempered by erysipelas poison for many years, a normal person with no inner breath would probably die of exhaustion.

The loud shout full of murderous intent startled Li Chen who was about to get up. He hid behind the barrel and slightly exposed his head to look into the distance.

Under the dark night light, a pair of eyes flashed with strange eyes.

In the woods not far away, there were continuous bangs and bangs, and the sound of gold and iron was heard. The so-called night of murderous people with dark moon and high winds was a true portrayal of this time.

This place is in a remote place, covered by woods and piles of rocks, so no sound can be transmitted at all.

That is, Li Chen is here, right below, so he can hear it clearly.

After drinking tea, there was another faint scream in the distance, followed by the sound of stumbling, coming from far and near, making Li Chen's heart thump in his heart while he was hiding.

He hid here not for the sake of profit, but because he didn't want to be discovered by people who were obviously fighting among Xuanyun Sect disciples.

As his slave, any disciple can step on him. If he is discovered, the only thing waiting for him is to kill him and silence him.

Wherever there are people, there are fights. Due to facial defects since childhood and the inability to gather energy in his body, Li Chen, who is only fourteen or fifteen years old, is extremely mature in his heart and has long been used to the harshness of the world and the warmth of human relationships.

Over the past few months in the Xuanyun Sect, he had heard a lot. Apparently there was no harmony among the sect's disciples as he had imagined, and it was even more common for a number of disciples to disappear.

The rolling sound of bones made a continuous sound, driving a piece of gravel towards the mountain col.

Li Chen stared at the place where the black shadow fell, and held back a cup of tea for a long time.

Seeing that there was no more movement, Li Chen hesitated for a while, then got up and boldly approached.

Vaguely visible, two disciples in green were lying motionless among the rocks. Li Chen recognized that they were the exclusive clothes of the outer disciples.

One of them suddenly coughed several times with difficulty. He raised his head and saw Li Chen, "Help me!"

Li Chen shivered and hesitated for a while. The kind thoughts in his heart made him approach tentatively and reach out to help this person's shoulders.

A bright light flashed across Li Chen's eyes, it was the cold light of a weapon. In an instant, Li Chen's hair stood on end. His reflexes, which he had honed by being beaten many times by Miss Li Yuerong, the third daughter of the Li family, made him calm at this moment. Without hesitation, he lay back and kicked out.

There were two muffled sounds in succession, and the man was kicked away and hit into the rocks. He spat out a bloody arrow from his mouth, and the dagger with the cold light clattered down. He lay on the ground and twitched a few times without making any sound.

After taking a few deep breaths, Li Chen swallowed his saliva and looked at the man in Tsing Yi who had made no sound anymore, feeling a sense of fear in his heart.

But then, a sharp pain hit my heart, and I subconsciously looked towards my chest.

Under the left chest, blood trickled out, and a coldness suddenly covered the whole body. It was caused by excessive blood loss.

"No...I am not willing...I have...not yet become a warrior...let...let grandpa...rest in peace...close his eyes..."

There was a pop, and Li Chen's vision blurred for a while. He lay on his back and fell to the ground, muttering in his mouth, and a large amount of blood foam poured out.

It has only been a few months since I entered the Xuan Yun Sect. Although it is very difficult on weekdays, in this kind of sect, I may encounter an opportunity one day, which can release the shackles in the body, repair the inner breath like ordinary people, and fulfill Lao Li Tou's wish.

But I didn't expect that today, when I was kind-hearted, I encountered such a disaster. It really fulfilled the words that Lao Litou often said in the past - people's hearts are unpredictable!

His perseverance kept him from fainting. He turned his body forcefully and reached into the arms of the other person lying down.

Li Chen recognized that it was a low-grade breath gathering pill distributed by the outer disciples of Xuanyun Sect, but it was a pity that it was of no use to him.

Fighting back the dizziness in his heart, he reached out again and found a jade box the size of a palm. He took it out and opened it with great effort. Inside was a crystal core the size of a walnut, mottled and emitting light fluorescence.

Li Chen narrowed his eyes, took a deep breath, and looked at the demon core, the light in his eyes flickering.

Although they knew that the two would definitely compete for some kind of treasure, they never imagined that it would be the demon core.

Judging from the size of this demon core, it is clear that it belongs to a late-stage first-order demon beast. This kind of strength must be dealt with by warriors above the seventh level of the Condensation Realm.

This kind of demon core is enough to compare with several high-grade energy-gathering pills, or even dozens of them.

The Li family has been a full-time medicine slave for three years. All kinds of useless pills and completed pills, no matter what kind of medicine they are, are of no use to him except that his body is much stronger than that of ordinary warriors.

Except for the demon core, he has never seen it, let alone tried it!

But the demon core cannot be taken directly. It contains the unique demon energy of demon beasts, which is an extremely violent and destructive force.

If you take it rashly, your meridians will be torn apart by the demonic energy and your body will explode and you will die. A powerful warrior can use his cultivation to refine and eliminate the demonic energy, or he can use special means, but this is only for demonic cores whose cultivation is lower than his own. If the cultivation is equal, it is extremely difficult to succeed.

For people like Li Chen who don't even have inner breath, let alone the late-stage first-order demon core, even at the early stage, it is enough to kill him on the spot, not to mention that he is seriously injured now.

With his body getting weaker and weaker, Li Chen made a move, gritted his teeth, opened his mouth and stuffed the entire demon core into his mouth.

He swallowed it with a gulp. It was not as hard as he expected, but a cold wave ran through his body, making Li Chen shiver, and then a sharp pain spread throughout his body from his belly.

Desperately suppressing the severe pain in his body, cold sweat dripped down his whole body, Li Chen gritted his teeth and persisted. He stood up and sat cross-legged on the ground, holding his hands on his Dantian, and started the "Rongyang Jue", an advanced skill of the Li family that he had mastered over the past three years.

This was when he first became a medicine slave, and he had reached the point of condensing his inner energy in just over a month. The senior management of the Li family specially gave it to him in order to win over him, and even intended to get married. However, he turned out to be a waste body that could not condense his inner energy.

The energy and blood in his body surged, and he spit out three blood arrows in succession. The pain was like tearing apart the soul. Even though Li Chen had suffered from three years of body refining with waste elixirs, he almost couldn't bear it and lost his skills.

Fortunately, his will had been tempered to be extremely strong, and he managed to hold on. However, the wound on his left chest, stirred by the violent demonic power, immediately spurted out a cloud of blood mist.

His face was covered with bulging veins, his eyes were wide open and full of bloodshot eyes. Li Chen felt that his whole body was about to explode. No one could see it. The ugly scar on his left cheek suddenly flashed with a frightening dark red blood.
